collab.role.view: You can view this note. Changes and comments need a link with more access.
collab.role.comment: You can read and comment on this note, not change it.
share.title: Share
share.intro: Anyone with a link gets its access until it expires or you revoke it. The server holds everyone to their role; a revoked link stops working within seconds.
share.needSession: Start or join a collaboration session to share this note.
share.needServer: Share links need a collab server (Collab settings → Persistent server).
share.notOwner: This note was shared with you. Only its owner can make links.
share.label: Who it's for (optional)
share.copied: Copied. The link carries the room key: send it only to the person it is for.
share.error.owner-required: Only the note's owner can manage its links.
share.error.unauthorized: The collab server refused the access key (Collab settings).
share.error.unreachable: The collab server can't be reached.
share.error.timeout: The collab server didn't answer in time.
share.needEncrypted: Sharing needs an end-to-end encrypted room. Start a new collaboration session: every new room has its own key.
share.e2ee: End-to-end encrypted: the room key stays in the link, after the #, and never reaches the server. The server stores and relays only ciphertext, presence included.
